evidence.why: module_init is registered via PyO3's #[pymodule_init] proc-macro attribute inside the #[pymodule] mod _pydantic_core block; PyO3's macro expansion generates the actual call invoked by Python at module import time, which is invisible to Ariadne's pre-expansion AST parse, matching the in-scope rust-macro-invocation-call rule's stated coverage of custom proc macros hiding function calls.
